The diagram shows a vertical wire carrying a current I placed between the poles of a magnet.
I
What is the direction of the force on the wire exerted by the magnetic field?
A
from N to S
B
from S to N
C
horizontal and at right angles to the direction from N to S
D
parallel to the wire

options.label: C
options.text: horizontal and at right angles to the direction from N to S
